label: Car Archetype
description: What KIND of car it is, in the words enthusiasts use — supercar, muscle car, hot rod, JDM tuner, restomod. The design-base and design-accent sections name specific machines; this is the class above them, and it was the axis missing when someone typed 'muscle car' and the library had 42 vehicle sections and no answer.

items.name: supercar
items.text: a mid-engined supercar, cab-forward proportions over a long rear deck, huge intakes feeding the flanks and a low wide stance on staggered wheels
items.text_short: mid-engined supercar, cab-forward and wide

items.name: hypercar
items.text: a hypercar built to a lap time, active aero standing proud of the bodywork, exposed carbon weave and a cockpit pulled forward between the axles
items.text_short: active-aero hypercar in exposed carbon

items.name: muscle-car
items.text: an American muscle car, a long flat hood over a big-block V8, squared shoulders, a blacked-out grille and fat rubber under minimal arches
items.text_short: American muscle car, long hood over a big-block V8

items.name: pony-car
items.text: a pony car in its classic proportion, short deck and long hood, fastback roofline, side scoops and a simple round-lamp face
items.text_short: classic pony car, long hood and short deck

items.name: hot-rod
items.text: a chopped and channelled hot rod, exposed chromed engine standing above the cowl, no fenders over the front wheels, pinstriping and raked stance
items.text_short: chopped hot rod, engine standing proud

items.name: lowrider
items.text: a lowrider laid out on hydraulics, candy paint over deep flake, wire wheels with whitewalls and murals worked into the panels
items.text_short: hydraulic lowrider in candy flake on wires

items.name: jdm-tuner
items.text: a JDM tuner build, period-correct bolt-on aero and a bolted wing, deep-dish wheels with stretched tyres and a roll cage visible through the glass
items.text_short: JDM tuner build with period aero and a cage

items.name: drift-missile
items.text: a stripped drift car, mismatched panels and a bashed bumper, huge angle kit at the front wheels, a hydraulic handbrake and a bare interior
items.text_short: stripped drift missile, mismatched panels

items.name: kei-car
items.text: a kei-class microcar, tall narrow body on tiny wheels, upright glasshouse and a face designed to be liked rather than feared
items.text_short: tall narrow kei microcar on tiny wheels

items.name: restomod
items.text: a restomod, classic bodywork restored to better than new over modern running gear, flush glass, subtly widened arches and contemporary wheels in a period pattern
items.text_short: restomod: classic body, modern running gear

items.name: grand-tourer
items.text: a grand tourer, a long bonnet and short overhangs, a cabin set well back, restrained brightwork and a stance tuned for distance rather than lap times
items.text_short: grand tourer, long bonnet and cabin set back

items.name: roadster
items.text: an open two-seat roadster, folded soft top behind the cabin, a low belt line, twin humps over the seats and a windscreen raked hard
items.text_short: open two-seat roadster, top folded away

items.name: rally-car
items.text: a rally car in service livery, mud packed into the arches, extra lamp pod across the nose, sump guard and gravel-spec suspension standing tall
items.text_short: rally car in service livery, mud-packed arches

items.name: group-b-era
items.text: a Group B-era competition car, boxed arches over enormous rubber, ducting cut wherever it was needed and aerodynamics that look bolted on because they were
items.text_short: Group B-era car, boxed arches and bolted-on aero

items.name: off-roader
items.text: a serious off-roader on a ladder frame, high ground clearance and knobbly tyres, snorkel up the A-pillar, roof rack and recovery gear strapped to the flanks
items.text_short: ladder-frame off-roader with snorkel and rack

items.name: pickup-truck
items.text: a pickup truck with a long open bed, a tall square grille, chrome mirrors on stalks and honest work marks along the load lip
items.text_short: long-bed pickup with a tall square grille

items.name: shooting-brake
items.text: a shooting brake, a coupe nose carried into a long straight roofline, a frameless tailgate and a load bay finished like a cabin
items.text_short: shooting brake: coupe nose, long straight roof

items.name: sleeper-saloon
items.text: a sleeper saloon, four doors and dull paint hiding a heavily built engine, standard trim, small wheels and an exhaust note that gives it away
items.text_short: dull four-door sleeper hiding a built engine

items.name: hot-hatch
items.text: a hot hatch, a short three-door body dropped over wide wheels, a tailgate spoiler, twin exits and a chassis obviously stiffer than the shell suggests
items.text_short: hot hatch dropped over wide wheels

items.name: pre-war-classic
items.text: a pre-war classic, separate sweeping wings over spoked wheels, an upright chrome radiator, running boards and a folded fabric roof
items.text_short: pre-war classic, sweeping wings and spoked wheels

items.name: land-speed-streamliner
items.text: a land-speed streamliner, a needle-nosed body faired over every wheel, a tail fin standing behind the cockpit and salt crusted along the underside
items.text_short: needle-nosed land-speed streamliner

items.name: electric-crossover
items.text: a modern electric crossover, a closed smooth face without a grille, flush handles and aero wheel covers, a single light bar spanning the nose
items.text_short: electric crossover, closed face and aero covers
